articles.summary: Administrative demands, harder-to-explain investments, and growing client expectations continue to compete for advisors’ time despite rapid AI adoption. Morningstar, Inc. (Nasdaq: MORN), a leading provider of independent investing insights, today released its annual Morningstar Investors Perspectives Advisor study, the third installment in the 2026 Morningstar Investor Perspectives series. Following research on retail investors and asset owners , the study provides new insight into how advisors are responding to AI adoption, rising client expectations, and market uncertainty. The findings reveal a growing paradox: advisors are embracing AI at pace, but many still feel they lack sufficient time to focus on clients. “AI is helping advisors run faster, but the treadmill is speeding up too,” said Joe Agostinelli, senior director of market research at Morningstar . “More documentation, faster service expectations, and more client questions mean AI is absorbing complexity rather than simply
articles.title: Advisors Adopt AI Fast, but Still Aren’t Getting Their Time Back, Says 2026 Morningstar Investor Perspectives Advisor Study

articles.summary: Morningstar Public/Private Select Series combines Morningstar Wealth's portfolio construction and due diligence with streamlined implementation through Envestnet Morningstar (Nasdaq: MORN) today announced that its Morningstar Wealth division will make the Morningstar Public/Private Select Series available through Envestnet, giving financial advisors a streamlined way to implement professionally constructed portfolios spanning public and private markets. Announced earlier this year , the Morningstar Public/Private Select Series was developed by Morningstar Wealth in collaboration with Apollo, Franklin Templeton and J.P. Morgan Asset Management to bring complementary public and private market capabilities together within a single portfolio framework. articles.title: Morningstar Wealth and Envestnet Expand Advisor Access to Public and Private Markets
